description: This source file implements utility functions for reading and writing kernel log monitor events, including JSON parsing and file descriptor I/O operations within the 'cuttlefish::monitor' namespace.

methods.name: ReadEvent
methods.description: Reads a log event from a file descriptor, parsing JSON data and returning a result with event type and metadata.

methods.name: WriteEvent
methods.description: Serializes a JSON event message and writes it to a file descriptor, including size prefix.
